items.title: Rebuild Missing Files: read Vortex's DB so Workshop collections with no local collection.json show up at all
items.why: Shipped: the per-card "Refresh from Nexus" button for collections already on disk (commit 4fedf7d). Still open: Missing Files' picker only scans local staging folders, so a Workshop collection that's never been extracted (no collection.json on disk yet, e.g. "My GTS Audio Overhaul") is invisible to it — Rebuild Collection solves this today by reading Vortex's DB directly. Bring that same read here so those collections can be bootstrapped through this tool too.
items.prompt:
REMAINING SCOPE after the "Refresh from Nexus" button shipped (commit 4fedf7d) — that part is done and verified live, don't redo it.

Still open, director's own follow-up: some Workshop collections have NO collection.json on disk at all (e.g. "My GTS Audio Overhaul", confirmed in the last handoff — never been extracted), so `listPickableCollections` (`lib/missing-files-scan.js`, scans local staging folders only) never sees them. Rebuild Collection already solves exactly this by reading Vortex's own database directly to discover 'Workshop-only' collections — name, modId, and the Nexus `collectionSlug` (not recoverable from anywhere on disk if there's no collection.json). See `lib/collection-runner.js`'s `loadSyncStateBatch` and `web/rebuild-routes.js`'s `/vortex-data/refresh` (~line 24, 41-58, 292-305), which populates `workshopOnlyCollections`, then `/collections` (~line 127-167) merges that into what the picker shows.

SCOPE:
1. Add the same Vortex-DB read to `listPickableCollections`/its own `/collections` route, reusing `collection-runner.js`'s shared primitive — don't reimplement Vortex-DB reading from scratch. Surface Workshop-only collections (no local collection.json) as pickable rows, each carrying its `collectionSlug`.
2. For an already-on-disk collection, the existing per-card 'Refresh from Nexus' action already covers refreshing it — no change needed there.
3. For a genuinely NEW Workshop-only row (no local collection.json yet — nothing to scan against), the flow is necessarily 'fetch from Nexus first, THEN scan' rather than 'scan, then optionally refresh.' Check whether the existing Step 1 → Step 2 picker flow needs a small branch for this (fetch-then-continue), or whether it's simplest to require a fetch before that row becomes scannable at all. This changes the picker's own basic behavior, not just adding a button — flag it as a judgment call with a small mockup addendum if the right UI flow isn't obvious, rather than guessing silently.
4. Add the 'Vortex must be closed' gate to this new DB read — the previous task deliberately deferred this (hit live: Vortex was open, the read failed with a confusing error) and the director's own call was to fold the fix in here rather than bolt it on piecemeal.

VERIFY live against "My GTS Audio Overhaul" specifically (confirmed in the last handoff to have no local collection.json) — confirm it now appears in the picker, can be fetched from Nexus, and becomes scannable afterward. Handoff with what you tested.

items.title: Missing-file list shows garbled slashes instead of real filenames for some mods
items.why: The expanded 'missing files' list for at least one mod (Dragon Voiced Word Walls, 63 missing) shows a string of stray slashes instead of readable filenames — this worked before the recent Extract fix, so it's likely a regression in how destination paths get computed for this mod's archive structure.
items.prompt:
MANDATORY LIVE DEBUGGING against the director's real data — do not guess. Real repro: 'Dragon Voiced Word Walls' (collection 'GTS Audio Overhaul - Resurrected') shows '63 missing' but the expanded file list renders as a long run of stray '/' characters joined by commas, not real filenames — screenshot confirms. This worked correctly before the recent Extract-fix commit (source/destination split); the director confirmed it 'were there originally, but now gone'.

GROUNDING: `web/public/rebuild-missing-app.js`'s `rmfBuildMissingCell` (~line 234-253) already correctly maps `row.missing` entries via `.destination` for display — that code itself looks right. This strongly suggests the actual `destination` STRINGS being computed for this specific mod's files are themselves broken (each one reducing to just '/' or a near-empty fragment), not a display bug — i.e. the bug is upstream, in `lib/missing-files-scan.js`'s `resolveExpectedDestinations` / `lib/simple-installer.js`'s `resolveSimpleInstall` (or `resolveChoices` if this mod has recorded FOMOD choices — check `mod.choices?.type` first to know which path applies).

INVESTIGATE LIVE using the director's real collection/archive for this exact mod:
1. Find 'Dragon Voiced Word Walls' in the real 'GTS Audio Overhaul - Resurrected' collection.json, get its `mod.source` and `mod.choices`.
2. `listArchive` its real archive, dump the raw entries (paths) to see the actual structure — is this an unusually deep/flat/oddly-named archive that could trip up `findPathPrefix`'s stop-pattern matching?
3. Run `resolveExpectedDestinations` (or `resolveSimpleInstall`/`resolveChoices` directly, whichever path applies) against the real data and print the actual computed `{source, destination}` pairs — confirm whether `destination` really is coming out as just '/' or similar garbage for these files.
4. If confirmed: find WHY. Candidate causes to check, don't assume which without verifying: (a) the detected mod-root prefix ends up being almost the ENTIRE path for this mod's files (a stop-pattern match landing very late in the path for some structural reason specific to this archive), (b) a path-separator inconsistency (archive entries using '/' vs '\\' inconsistently) confusing the prefix-strip math, (c) something specific to this mod having recorded FOMOD choices that `resolveChoices` mishandles differently than `resolveSimpleInstall` does.

FIX the real, confirmed cause. Given this apparently regressed with the recent source/destination-split commit, also diff that commit's own changes to `resolveExpectedDestinations` against what it looked like before, in case the regression is literally in that refactor rather than a pre-existing latent bug newly exposed by the display fix.

VERIFY: re-run the real scan for this collection, confirm 'Dragon Voiced Word Walls' shows real, readable filenames in its missing-file list, not garbled slashes. Spot-check a couple of the OTHER currently-good-looking mods too, to make sure the fix doesn't disturb them. Handoff with what the real archive structure/computed paths actually looked like — don't report fixed without showing the real before/after data.

items.title: Clear stale end-of-flow banner on Preview re-arm
items.prompt: In Update Collection: re-doing Apply Ignores via Preview doesn't clear the stale end-of-flow completion banner until Apply re-succeeds. Wire callout-clearing into the Preview re-arm so the banner clears the moment the step is re-armed. Pre-existing minor issue; not blocking.
